Three ways to fly

Mini 4 Pro pairs a compact airframe with vertical shooting. Air 3S adds a 1-inch wide camera and a separate medium telephoto camera. Avata 2 is built around immersive FPV viewing and integrated propeller guards.

summary: Discover cordless pool-cleaning robots with dedicated floor, wall, waterline and surface-cleaning functions.
html_content:
Beatbot: pool care, automated

Discover cordless pool-cleaning robots with dedicated floor, wall, waterline and surface-cleaning functions.

Understand the cleaning coverage

AquaSense 2 Pro combines five cleaning functions with sensor-based navigation. AquaSense 2 Ultra adds camera-assisted HybridSense mapping. Both support water clarification using compatible consumables.

Compare pool shape, water depth, surface material and the areas you need cleaned. Maximum runtime depends on the cleaning mode; surface-cleaning figures should not be read as floor-cleaning runtime.

summary: Compare robot vacuums that combine vacuuming, spinning mops and automatic dock maintenance.
html_content:
Roborock: everyday floor care

Compare robot vacuums that combine vacuuming, spinning mops and automatic dock maintenance.

Choose the right navigation and dock

Saros 10R uses StarSight navigation in a 7.98 cm body and works with Multifunctional Dock 4.0. Qrevo Curv combines PreciSense LiDAR with Reactive AI obstacle recognition and Multifunctional Dock 3.0.

Check furniture clearance, carpets, thresholds and space for the dock. Washing, drying and emptying reduce daily tasks, but brushes, tanks, filters and mop cloths still need regular care.

Choose your DJI drone

Start with the footage you want, then compare size, cameras and the included controller.

Travel and vertical content

Mini 4 Pro offers true vertical shooting and weighs under 249 g with its standard battery. Battery choice changes both flight time and aircraft weight.

Two camera perspectives

Air 3S pairs a wide camera with a 70 mm medium telephoto camera, giving you different framing options without changing the aircraft.

Immersive FPV

Avata 2 uses goggles for an immersive view. The listed single-battery Fly More Combo includes Goggles 3 and RC Motion 3. Its downward and backward positioning is different from the omnidirectional sensing on the two camera drones.

Before choosing

Read the exact box configuration, phone requirements, battery compatibility and manufacturer flight-time test conditions on each product page. Maximum flight times are not guaranteed real-world durations.

summary: Match cleaning coverage and navigation to the shape and surfaces of your pool.
html_content:
Choose your Beatbot pool robot

Match cleaning coverage and navigation to the shape and surfaces of your pool.

Which areas need cleaning?

Compare floor, wall, waterline and surface functions separately. AquaSense 2 Pro and Ultra also support water clarification with compatible consumables.

Navigation and pool layout

Pro uses CleverNav with 22 sensors. Ultra adds HybridSense camera-assisted mapping with 27 sensors. For raised platforms, check the manufacturer minimum water depth; Ultra specifies at least 35 cm over platforms for platform cleaning.

Runtime and maintenance

Read the cleaning-mode label beside every runtime claim. Pro’s up-to-11-hour figure applies to surface cleaning only. Empty and rinse the filters, follow charging instructions and check consumable compatibility.

summary: Consider floors, furniture clearance and dock maintenance before comparing headline suction ratings.
html_content:
Choose your Roborock vacuum

Consider floors, furniture clearance and dock maintenance before comparing headline suction ratings.

Floors and furniture

Measure the space beneath furniture and identify carpets, hard floors and thresholds. Saros 10R has a 7.98 cm robot body. Confirm clearance and floor settings against the exact model documentation.

Mopping and docking

Both listed models use spinning mops. Saros 10R offers automatic mop removal through Dock 4.0. Qrevo Curv uses Dock 3.0 with mop washing, drying, refilling and dust emptying. The listed Saros 10R is the standard dock version, not the separate refill-and-drainage configuration.

Accessories that fit

Replacement mop cloths must match the model. Our Saros 10R / Z70 four-pack is not listed for Qrevo Curv. Keep filters, brushes and tanks on the manufacturer maintenance schedule.
